source: Quiz 3 - Sessions 1-4: Model Size, Thinking, and Skills
question: What is seat-minder, the app the instructor demoed at the start of session 4?

options.text: A grading tool that scores lab reports against a rubric
options.feedback: That is the grading-skill demo described later in the session, not seat-minder. Seat-minder handles check-in and cold-calling, not grading.

options.text: A scheduling tool for booking office hours
options.feedback: Office-hours booking never comes up in the notes. Seat-minder is about in-class check-in and cold-calling, not appointment scheduling.

options.text: A check-in and cold-calling web app for the class
options.feedback: Students scan a QR code and tap their seat to check in, and the app then lets the instructor see who is present, who has opted in to being called on, and pull up a photo and name before calling on someone.

options.text: A skill-editing tool for revising the lecture-notes skill
options.feedback: Editing the lecture-notes skill was a separate part of the session, a different exercise from building seat-minder.
